get_company_financials.description: Get annual income and expenses by taxpayer INN.

id.description: Key returned by search. An INN with multiple registrations returns 409.

get_company_profile.description: Get the profile and section availability.

id.description: Key returned by search. An INN with multiple registrations returns 409.

get_company_sources.description: Get the releases and documents used by the company response.

id.description: Key returned by search. An INN with multiple registrations returns 409.

get_company_taxes.description: Get published tax payments, debts or special regimes.

as_of.description: Exact observation date for debts and regimes. Defaults to the latest loaded snapshot for the subject type.

limit.description: Payment or debt page size. Omit for regimes.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous payment or debt page. Omit for regimes.

section.description: Select one section per call. For regimes only id and optionally as_of are needed.

year.description: Exact report year for payments. Defaults to all loaded years.

search_companies.description: Search published FNS observations and optional DaData registrations.

limit.description: Local page size. Exact searches can also return DaData registrations on the first page.

q.description: Company name or a bare INN, OGRN or OGRNIP number. For exact lookups omit the inn:/reg: prefix used by detail tools.
